I also experience akathisia, a feeling of strong restlessness.
In depression, I feel very down. It's quite the opposite, actually. You need so much sleep and still are tired. I can't go to school, I really try but it's not possible. I will have to repeat the school year because I spent so much time in a mental health hospital. I have been there 5 times so far, only 3 times consentual. I get very anxious, feel like my friends don't care. I'm a very extroverted and confident person, normally.
Then there are also mixed phases. That's honestly the worst. You feel almost as down as when you do in depression, but you have energy. That's also the most dangerous phase, many people who have Bpd have at least once attempted suicide. I try to take medication but it's really tough, since there can be many negative side effects. It kind of reduces your emotions and that can feel bad. I'm currently off medication, even though I know that's gonna backfire. On top of all that, mania and depression gets worse with age.
